description: A(D) follow-up to the GAP-A-3 §4 flat-baseline probe: the Phase-4-derived A(D) vs the flat baseline. Quantifies how far the binding P_lambda must deviate from flat (P_lambda=1) for the deuteron. No fit; no P_lambda proposed.
verdict: Phase-4 A(D)=22.98 (not the 11.21 a flat P_lambda would need); the flat baseline overshoots the deuteron binding by ~2.05x, so the bar-even P_lambda must suppress the effective trace to ~48.8% of flat. With #2626 (flat trace is bar-mixed), the deuteron P_lambda must bar-symmetrise AND ~halve the trace. The ~2.05 overshoot is consistent with exactly 2 within A(D)'s <=2.5% band but NOT pinned; a clean factor-1/2 (or any specific P_lambda) would be a fit and is NOT asserted.
discipline: No fit; no 7th ansatz; no P_lambda proposed; nothing wired; c_k/Delta_lambda cal-anchored.
